directives.directive: If execution pauses or a loop iteration finishes without an explicit user stop/cancel, automatically continue to the next optimization loop instead of waiting for confirmation.
directives.context: Looping optimization workflow for mlsys26 GDN kernels

directives.directive: For the mlsys26 optimization workflow, continue loop iterations automatically without waiting for confirmation until the user explicitly stops/cancels or there have been 10 consecutive non-meaningful iterations that were reverted. Use the full 100-workload decision gate as the final keep/revert criterion.

For optimization loop keep/revert decisions, use the full 100-workload arithmetic-mean latency as the primary criterion. Quick runs are only working gates. The current full decision-gate config is warmup_runs=1, iterations=5, num_trials=1.
directives.context: Updated loop rule per user: full average latency decides keep vs revert
